about: Chapter 1: she looks the organizers up online (evidence_table `screen`): a search home page, the query typed, then a full results page; generic results only. One fixed camera centre (start_center = focus + end_offset) frames the home field at the start and the results field at the top at the end, so the camera only eases back a little (3.1 to 2.8) and the query stays big enough to read on a phone (x-height about 31 px at the end).
